'''Fudbalski klub Turbina Jablanica''' ({{lang-sh-Cyrl|Фудбалски клуб Турбина Јабланица}}; {{Literal translation|Football Club Turbina Jablanica}}) is a professional [[association football]] club based in the town of [[Jablanica, Bosnia and Herzegovina|Jablanica]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

Turbina currently competes in the [[Second League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] (South), the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina football league system|third tier of Bosnian football]]. The club plays its home matches at the Jablanica City stadium, which has a capacity of 2,000 seats.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/bosnia-herzegovina/turbina-jablanica/30129/|title=FK Turbina Jablanica|accessdate=20 June 2019|language=English|website=int.soccerway.com}}</ref>

Turbina has produced a number of famous players in its history, most notably [[Vahid Halilhodžić]] and [[Hasan Salihamidžić]]."}}
